main_body: Conical snow-covered fir: a stack of dark green tiers with white snow bands and a small brown trunk
top_band: No horizontal top surface. At x=15 the column reads pale snow at rows 2-3 (the tip), then dark green rows 5-13, then alternating 1-3 row snow drapes and green runs down to the trunk. The snow bands are drapes on the tiers, not a top face.
evidence: The tree is a symmetric cone drawn straight from the front. Only a 2-row snow tip sits at the apex, and the 1-3 row snow bands across the tiers are decoration on the face, not a surface seen from above. No tier shows a visible top ellipse, and no eave shadow or front-edge step separates a top from a face. This is the front-elevation case with no real top, so it fails strictly.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 13 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile. The references have 427-567 colours and a median of about 108 per tile. The outline is tinted dark navy and green, with 0% near-neutral edge pixels, so it is not a black sticker line. The shading is a flat 3-4 step green ramp plus 3 snow tones, with little leaf-clump or needle texture, so it reads much thinner than the lush references. Flat-fill coverage is low at 5%, but the density gap is large.
